purpose: Define a small source-side variant set for proving that humanoid head shape controls produce different compiled geometry before any join or watertight mesh pass.

variants.purpose: Baseline measured head using the taxonomy defaults.
variants.read_goal: Keeps the current neutral scaffold as the comparison target.

variants.purpose: Push brow arc, socket slant, face wrap, and embed overlap so the face reads with heavier shadow structure.
variants.read_goal: Brow and orbital band should visibly dominate without changing the whole head profile.

variants.purpose: Reduce ridge strength and nose mass for a softer flatter mannequin face.
variants.read_goal: Face should read calmer, with smaller nose and weaker shadow cuts.

variants.purpose: Widen the lower face and reduce taper so the jaw and chin carry more weight.
variants.read_goal: Lower face should read heavier while the skull remains close to the baseline.

variants.purpose: Narrow the breadth measurements while increasing face length to prove measured anchors can participate in variant generation.
variants.read_goal: Silhouette should become taller and narrower without breaking symmetry or overlaps.

quality_checks: all control overrides reference existing taxonomy controls
all control override values sit inside allowed_range
all measurement overrides reference existing measured dimensions
each compiled variant has a unique geometry signature
all mirrored L/R parts stay symmetric
all non-base parts keep connection rules and AABB contact with their parent
global bounds remain in the expected humanoid head range
